instructions: An Iterate StackChan with health metrics, screen, head servos, RGB LEDs, camera, and full-duplex AEC voice. PCM media uses the target's separate realtime WebSocket lane.

children.subscribeToMetrics: Call a callback immediately and once per configured interval with bounded runtime metrics.
children.subscribeToAecMetrics: Call a callback with the latest aligned near, speaker-reference, and clean AEC signal window plus bounded timing and failure counters.
children.subscribeToEvents: Call one callback with the current push-to-talk snapshot and each later processed call or talk transition.
children.getDiagnostics: Return one retained control-transport incident snapshot.
children.renderOnScreen: Download and render a PNG from {url}.
children.changeColour: Fill the screen with red or green.

conversation.interruptPlayback: Purge assistant speech and acknowledge only after the physical speaker owner has reset.

children.leds: RGB LEDs; call leds.set(...) or leds.fill(...).
children.takePhoto: Capture and return one bounded image byte array.
